locked.why: Best development median error among models whose inputs a King parcel layer carries (the WA statewide layer: tax-year-2026 land + building value only): regression on the neighborhood median and that value 8.0% (3818 sales) vs value x sales ratio 8.05%. Best overall needs rooms and size, which no King page layer has: regression with the assessor value 7.5%; without it 9.6%; $/sqft x size 12.6%; neighborhood median 16.3%. Even if it passes, the page cannot run it today: its King parcel service is the county zoning layer (PIN and zoning only).
